svg.text: Submit at most 300 s before launch
a step joins the job line before it
a forged line no longer removes it
4 · one row per job and dir
two final records: still no row
no row: up to 3 calls, then None
asked during a call: queued again,
dropped lines logged once per run
Slurm may record a resolved WorkDir
where the engine gives a symlink
no per-run guard: a slow file system
fixed in e97cfdf, one resolve per run
on every view: real jobs starved
a newline in WorkDir bound a cut
tests is synthetic, TZ to be
